meta.name: E! Keeping Up: Keeping Up With the Kardashians
meta.description:
Keep up with each breakup and breakdown from the first family of reality TV, the Kardashian/Jenners. The E! Keeping Up Vault has every episode and spin off that created an empire. Relive it all now.

Shows: Keeping Up With the Kardashians, Kourtney and Kim Take New York, Kourtney & Khloé Take Miami, Kourtney & Kim Take Miami, Kourtney & Khloé Take the Hamptons
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
